description.value: Anna's Cake House is a beloved family-owned Hong Kong-style bakery founded in 1974 by Anna, Ronald, and Kathleen Cheung, now celebrating 50 years of operation across four Greater Vancouver locations. The Richmond outpost sits inside Lansdowne Mall and offers freshly baked, made-to-order cakes in over 15 flavours — made daily with no artificial additives, using Canadian butter and cream. Cyclists looking for a sweet stop will find a well-established community institution known for Hong Kong-style buns and layered cream cakes.
